title: Wali wa Nazi
description: Wali wa Nazi is a Tanzania classic prepared with white rice, coconut milk, toasted coconut flakes. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Spread the rice evenly into the flavorful liquid. Cook uncovered or partly covered for about 27 minutes until the liquid is absorbed; do not over-stir.
Take off the heat and let the rice rest under a clean towel or lid for about 10 minutes before serving.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
